services.title: Anarkali

services.title: Blouse
services.description: Precision-tailored designer blouses crafted with flawless neckline fit, clean bust darts, and high-quality boutique finishing. Styles include Basic Blouse, Princess-Cut, Padded Blouse, Designer & Bridal Blouse, Traditional, Backless / Tie-Back, and Collar / Shirt-Style Blouse.

services.title: Bottom Wear (Pant / Salwar)
services.description: Expertly cut and stitched ladies bottom wear ensuring comfort, flexibility, and a sharp silhouette. Styles include Cigarette / Straight Pants, Salwar, Patiala Salwar, Palazzo, Churidar, Dhoti Pants, and Tulip Pants.
